root.note: The image takes the class its parent gives it (salt-hero__image, salt-gallery__image and so on); media has no class of its own. sizes is derived from the image context (full, content, wide, aside, half, card, logo, thumb) and the band's width.

zeroState: Not drawn when the image does not resolve.

notes.text: Alt precedence is the parent's: an explicit alt, else the stored alt, else empty (decorative).
WordPress may emit picture with source elements (opt-in); Next emits img only. The contract allows img only until a fixture needs picture.

owes: Drop x-image; take the parent's class; derive sizes from the same contexts.
